description.value:
On the battlefield you become a graceful, deadly blur of blade and acrobatics. Your Dexterity score and your Wisdom or Charisma score (your choice) each rise by 2, as do their maximums. You may also spend your action to gain the following, all lasting for 1 minute:

  • You resist kinetic, energy, and ion damage dealt by weapons.
  • Whenever an ally within 30 feet of you takes the Attack action, it can make one additional attack as part of that same action.
  • Whenever you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you may move up to 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.

This benefit ends early if you're incapacitated or killed. You must complete a long rest before using it again.
